title: Move decisions
description: Every resource decision a planned move raises, grouped by category. Empty arrays where the category does not apply.

coal.description: One decision per coal cube. For a double rail build, one per link in the move's own link order, each planned after the previous link's consumption.

iron.description: One decision per iron cube. Iron needs no network connection, so candidates are every unflipped works plus the market.

beer.description: Flat list of barrels in tile order, not one entry per tile: a tile needing two barrels contributes two consecutive decisions.

merchant.description: Sell destination per tile, index-aligned to the move's tile-ids.
